# Mediabunny

`mediabunny-1.61.3.min.js` is the unmodified browser bundle
`dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.cjs` from Mediabunny 1.61.3, renamed for static
JavaScript serving. The copyright and MPL 2.0 header remain intact.

The MPL 2.0 license is included in `Mediabunny-LICENSE.txt`.
The corresponding source, including `src/`, is available in the published
[1.61.3 source archive](https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.61.3.tgz).
Upstream: [Vanilagy/mediabunny](https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny).

The bundle is shipped locally and precached for offline video export.
